title: AI Club Members Game Night
location: A private home near Coit Road & Belt Line Road, Dallas.
summary:
Games, puzzles, and time to hang out. No experience needed.
Hosted by Dallas College AI Club members. This event is independent of Dallas College.
Space for 10 people (12 maximum). We will share the date, exact address, games, and other details before you confirm a seat.
agenda: Play games and solve puzzles together.
preparation: Bring your own food and drinks.
surveyIntro:
Please reply by Sunday, October 11, 2026. This takes about 3 minutes.
Use your college or alumni email address ending in .edu. Dallas College students may use their student e-number email.
We will share the final details before asking you to confirm a seat.
